name: dbNSFP
maintainer: dbNSFP team (commercial licences via Genos Bioinformatics LLC)

version.value: August 2026 release (GENCODE 50 / Ensembl 116); column docs v5.4a

scope: Functional annotations and deleteriousness predictions for all possible non-synonymous SNVs (86,701,498 nsSNVs) and splice-site SNVs (2,582,202 ssSNVs) from 37 algorithms (e.g. SIFT, PolyPhen-2, CADD, REVEL, AlphaMissense, ESM1b, popEVE), plus conservation scores and allele frequencies (1000 Genomes, gnomAD v4.1, others).
mapping_methods: Predictions precomputed per variant on GENCODE transcripts.

licence.name: Academic branch CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (about 50 GB); commercial branch under paid licence
licence.redistribution: No derivatives and non-commercial; do not commit or republish data or transformed copies
licence.note: Registration with an institutional email and an access code is required before download links are issued.

coverage_limitations: Missense/splice-site SNVs only; no indels, CNVs or SVs
known_omissions: Several upstream scores excluded from the commercial branch

reuse_decision.rationale: Best single consolidated source of missense predictors and frequencies. Not acquired: it needs the user to register with an institutional email.

status.notes: Site and licence pages readable; bulk download gated by registration.
